titulo: Five peas back in the jar
caption:
Five peas back in the jar

Five peas rolled off the counter. All five went back in the jar before dinner.

A pea under the fridge is still there at spring cleaning, and the jar was right there.

For whoever picks up what spilled right away, while it is still within reach.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a big clear jar on the right and five green peas scattered on the floor at the middle. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the peas hop one after another in small arcs into the jar. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: I'll get them later, to: got them all. none lost.
